headline: PICK RUSH: the belt learns to breathe
lede: The warehouse crane's conveyor no longer hums one flat seeded note. Each shift now runs three hand-authored waves — a name, a kind order, and a proper breather in between — so the line teaches: singles and a weave in shift one, glass in the second, rolling barrels third, and the scrap-strewn late rush last.

notes.text: Hand-authored belt waves shipped (#2210): named per-shift wave patterns with authored kind order and spacing, ±5-tick seeded jitter so repeats still vary, era ladder honoured, and each incoming wave announced at the belt mouth with an ice-blue caption and a two-note cue. Quotas and the parity rival stay exactly as tuned.
The merge freeze lifted: the red nightly was dvhcheck alone; the fix landed on main and the confirming nightly went green ~65 minutes later, so the factory is unblocked without quarantining anything.

pickcheck now carries five WAVES gates (authored order across seeds, era ladder, breathing, supply headroom, wave cue) plus a new `wave` mutant that the era ladder catches — the pacing pattern is pinned, so polish can decorate it but not break it.
QA picked up the follow-on (#2214): marquee-style wave banners, wave-family sound character, breather texture, and a phone-playtest pass on the two hardest authored moments.
